about: M5.2 tool choice, written 2026-10-28 before the router existed. Each label is the set of tools a question needs beyond the knowledge-base search every question gets: 'rules' when it asks for an official figure or rule the rules file covers (proof of funds, off-campus work hours, closed programs such as SDS, PGWP eligibility/length/language, PAL/TAL, Express Entry FSW/STEM, visitor visa/eTA, biometrics, whether approval can be guaranteed, and the study permit documents checklist: letter of acceptance, PAL, identity, funds incl. the GIC, when a medical exam or police certificate applies); 'profile' when the answer depends on the asker's own saved details (am I eligible, based on my profile/background); 'processing_times_link' when it asks how long IRCC takes. 'dev' may guide the router; 'holdout' is only measured, never tuned on. Done-criterion: >= 95% exact-set accuracy. 'holdout_2' (30 questions) was written after dev and the first held-out set had been used to build the router (2026-10-28), labelled before the router ran on it, and is measured once. 'holdout_3' (30 questions) was written after holdout_2 had been used to fix trigger gaps (2026-10-28), labelled before the router ran on it, and is measured once.
